p.s: Dear Kim.
Thank you for your lovely letter and I hope you are well.
The other day, I worked at a pop concert to help.
It was really interesting than I expected.
My job at behind the stage was helping make-up, hare and clothes staylist.
It was very hard.
The singers often changed them clothes and them make-up was easy to be off because of the sweat.
It was different from I did at college.
There was no time to rest.
But I met a lot of famous singer and spoke to them.
In front of the stage was so many people and they couldn't see them very well, but I was at very near from the stage and I could see them just there.
You like pop music, don't you?
So, don't go to a concert!
Work at a concert!
That's much more exciting.
Anyway, shall we meet sometime?
We haven't met each other so long time and I'll tell you more story of this.
Write soon,
Bye Bye.
